DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座のお申込みについてですね。どのようにお使いになる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to apply for an account, correct? How do you plan to use it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しい勤務先から給与を受け取るためです。初めてこの銀行に申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初回申込みで給与受取用の口座を希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: To receive my salary from my new employer. This is my first time applying at this bank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that this is your first application and you want an account to receive your salary. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 勤務先から、支店や口座の種類について指定はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did your employer specify a branch or account type?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 銀行名だけ指定されています。この給与の案内に書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 勤務先の銀行指定の範囲を説明し案内を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: They specified only the bank. It's written in these salary instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain what your employer specified about the bank and show the instructions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 拝見します。本人確認の書類には、今の住所が載っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let me see. Do your identification documents show your current address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 在留カードの裏に新しい住所があります。先週、住所を変えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 在留カードの現住所と住所変更時期を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: My new address is on the back of my residence card. I changed my address last week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain where your current address is on your residence card and when you changed it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの確認事項も含めて担当者が書類を拝見します。給与日はいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: A staff member will examine your documents along with the other items we need to check. When is payday?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今月の二十五日です。それまでに開設できなかった場合、勤務先へ何と伝えればよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 給与日を伝え開設が間に合わない場合の勤務先への説明を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The twenty-fifth of this month. If the account can't be opened by then, what should I tell my employer?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your payday and ask what to tell your employer if the account is not opened in time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 開設時期はここではお約束できません。申込み中であることを伝えて、給与の受け取り方を勤務先に相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can't promise an opening date here. Tell your employer your application is in progress and discuss how you can receive your salary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。今日は申込みの説明を聞いて、必要な書類をそろえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 申込みの説明を聞いて書類をそろえると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Today I'll listen to the application instructions and gather the necessary documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll listen to the application instructions and gather the documents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは担当者へおつなぎします。本日はありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll put you in touch with the staff member, then. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 米の値札をお探しですか。どの袋でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a price label for the rice? Which bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この緑の袋です。下に二枚値札があるので、どちらの値段かわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 緑の米袋に対応する値札がわからないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: This green bag. There are two labels underneath, so I don't know which price applies.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you don't know which price label applies to the green bag of rice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 緑の二キロ袋は千二百八十円です。隣の千九百八十円は、白い五キロ袋の値札です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The green two-kilogram bag is 1,280 yen. The 1,980-yen label next to it is for the white five-kilogram bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 緑は二キロで千二百八十円ですね。会員価格と書いてある札は何の分ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 容量と価格を確認し会員価格の対象を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the green one is two kilograms for 1,280 yen. What is the label saying “member price” for?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the weight and price and ask which item the member price applies to. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 白い五キロ袋の会員価格です。緑の袋は会員でなくても同じ値段です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's the member price for the white five-kilogram bag. The green bag costs the same even if you're not a member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人暮らしなので緑にします。この袋に持ち手はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二キロ袋を選び持ち手の有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I live alone, so I'll take the green one. Does this bag have a handle?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the two-kilogram bag and ask whether it has a handle. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 持ち手はありません。持ち帰り用の有料の袋はレジで買えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: It doesn't. You can buy a bag to carry it home at the checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 買い物袋を持ってきました。この大きさなら米の袋が入りそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持参した買い物袋に米が入るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I brought a shopping bag. Does this look big enough to fit the rice bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether the rice will fit in the shopping bag you brought. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、横に寝かせれば入る大きさです。持ち上げるときは、底にも手を添えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, it's big enough if you lay the rice bag on its side. When lifting it, support the bottom with a hand too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、この二キロを横に入れて持ち帰ります。値札の説明もありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 米を横に入れて持ち帰ると伝え説明への礼を言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll put this two-kilogram bag in sideways and take it home. Thank you for explaining the price labels too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll carry the rice home laid sideways in your bag, and thank them for the explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。お会計はあちらのレジでどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please pay at the checkout over there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。散歩道のご案内ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Would you like directions for a walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三十分ほど歩いて、この入口に戻りたいです。途中で座れる道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三十分程度で入口へ戻り途中で座れる道を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to walk for about thirty minutes and return to this entrance. Is there a route where I can sit down along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a route taking about thirty minutes back to the entrance, with somewhere to sit along the way. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 池の手前まで行って花壇沿いに戻る道なら、ゆっくり歩いて二十分ほどです。花壇の横にベンチがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you go as far as just before the pond and return along the flower beds, it's about twenty minutes at a leisurely pace. There's a bench beside the flower beds.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池を一周する道とは違うのですね。階段は通りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 池一周との違いと階段の有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So that's different from the path all the way around the pond. Are there any stairs?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how it differs from going around the pond and whether there are stairs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一周する道には階段がありますが、花壇沿いの道にはありません。小さな橋の手前で右へ曲がってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The path around the pond has stairs, but the one along the flower beds doesn't. Turn right before the little bridge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 橋は渡らず、手前で右ですね。ベンチは日陰にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 橋の前で曲がると確認しベンチの日陰を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I don't cross the bridge; I turn right before it. Is the bench in the shade?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm you'll turn before the bridge and ask whether the bench is shaded. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 大きな木の下にあります。そこからこの入口の時計が見えますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's under a large tree. You can see the clock at this entrance from there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 時計が見えるなら戻りやすそうです。花壇までの道は、砂利ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 時計を目印にできると伝え路面を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I can see the clock, getting back should be easy. Is the path to the flower beds gravel?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you can use the clock as a landmark and ask about the path surface. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 池までは舗装されています。花壇の横だけ砂利なので、足元にお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: It's paved as far as the pond. Only the section beside the flower beds is gravel, so watch your step.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。花壇のベンチで休んで、時計を目印に戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩場所と入口へ戻る目印を言い直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll rest on the bench by the flower beds and use the clock as my landmark to return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Restate where you'll rest and the landmark for returning to the entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ、ゆっくりお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your time and enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かお困りですか。改札はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need help? The ticket gates are this way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が西口で待っています。私は東口にいるのですが、反対側へ行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人の待つ出口への行き方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend is waiting at the west exit. I'm at the east exit; can I get to the other side?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to reach the exit where your friend is waiting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 改札には入らず、外の地下通路をお使いください。階段を下りて、向こう側で上がります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't go through the ticket gates. Use the public underground passage outside them. Go down the stairs, then up on the other side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 大きなスーツケースがあるのですが、エレベーターはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 荷物の事情を伝えエレベーターを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a large suitcase. Is there an elevator?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your luggage situation and ask about an elevator. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 地下通路にはありません。こちら側なら、駅前の時計の下で待ち合わせができます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: There isn't one in the underground passage. On this side, you can arrange to meet under the clock in front of the station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、友人にこちらへ来てもらいます。時計はどこにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 待ち合わせ場所を変更し時計の位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll ask my friend to come to this side. Where is the clock?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Change the meeting place and ask where the clock is. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 東口を出て左です。屋根の下に、丸い時計が掛かっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Turn left after leaving the east exit. A round clock hangs under the roof.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 出口を出て左ですね。そこにベンチもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 出口の方向を確認しベンチを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Left after leaving the exit, right? Is there a bench there too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the direction from the exit and ask about a bench. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 時計の向かいにあります。通行の邪魔にならないよう、荷物はベンチの横へ寄せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: There's one opposite the clock. Keep your luggage beside the bench so it doesn't block people passing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。時計の写真を送って、ベンチで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合流のための連絡と待つ場所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll send a photo of the clock and wait on the bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say how you'll contact your friend to meet up and where you'll wait. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、お連れ様と合流できるといいですね。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I hope you find each other. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申請書をお預かりします。住所はこちらでお間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll take your application form. Is this address correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません、前に住んでいた住所を書いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 申請書に旧住所を書いたことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry, I wrote the address where I used to live.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you wrote your old address on the application. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の住所に直していただけますか。書き直し用の用紙もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you correct it to your current address? We also have fresh forms if you want to rewrite it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 氏名などは書けているので、この用紙で訂正したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ用紙で訂正したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've already filled in my name and the other details, so I'd like to make the correction on this form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you'd like to correct the same form. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、間違った住所に二重線を引いて、下の余白に今の住所をお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then draw a double line through the incorrect address and write your current address in the blank space below.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここに部屋番号まで書けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 部屋番号の記入場所を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Should I write it here, including the apartment number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm where to write the apartment number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、建物名と部屋番号もお願いします。証明書は何通必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, please include the building name and apartment number too. How many copies of the certificate do you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一通です。部屋番号は二〇三で、今の住所を書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要な通数と訂正した住所の情報を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: One copy. The apartment number is 203, and I've written my current address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the number of copies you need and information about the corrected address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。本人確認の書類を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. May I see your identification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、こちらの在留カードです。住所の欄も更新されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人確認書類を提示し住所更新を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, here's my residence card. The address section has been updated too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Present your identification and say the address has been updated. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 拝見しますね。確認が済みましたら番号をお呼びしますので、お掛けになってお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let me check. We'll call your number when the check is complete, so please sit down and wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察の前に、お困りの症状を伺います。どこが痛みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before your examination, I'll ask about your symptoms. Where does it hurt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右の手首です。昨日から、物を持ち上げると痛みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 痛む部位と始まった時期を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My right wrist. Since yesterday, it hurts when I lift things.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain where it hurts and when it started. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 転んだり、どこかにぶつけたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you fall or hit it against anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、ぶつけていません。仕事で箱を何度も持ち上げました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 外傷の有無と手首を使った作業を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I haven't hit it. I lifted boxes repeatedly at work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say whether you injured it and describe the work involving your wrist. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのことも医師に伝えます。今、じっとしていても痛みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the doctor that too. Does it hurt now even when you keep it still?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 動かさなければあまり痛くありません。仕事を休む必要があるか、診察で聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 安静時の状態と医師に聞きたいことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: It doesn't hurt much if I don't move it. I'd like to ask the doctor during the examination whether I need time off work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe how it feels at rest and what you'd like to ask the doctor. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: わかりました。仕事の内容と、休む必要があるか知りたいことを申し送りします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. I'll pass on what your work involves and that you want to know whether you need time off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 説明を聞くとき、メモを取ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 診察でメモを取る許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: May I take notes while listening to the explanation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask permission to take notes during the consultation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。聞き取れなかったら、医師にもう一度説明してほしいとお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. If you don't catch something, please ask the doctor to explain it again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。箱の重さも、忘れないようにメモしておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 医師に伝える作業の情報を記録すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll also note down the weight of the boxes so I don't forget.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll record information about your work to tell the doctor. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お名前をお呼びするまで、こちらでお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait here until we call your name. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どうされましたか。こちらへお掛けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What happened? Please sit down here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 朝置いた自転車が、帰りに見つかりませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自転車が見つからないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I came back, I couldn't find the bicycle I'd parked in the morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help because you can't find your bicycle. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どこに止めて、何時ごろ戻られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where did you park it, and about what time did you return?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅の北側の駐輪場です。八時に止めて、五時に戻りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駐輪した場所と時間帯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: In the bicycle parking area north of the station. I parked it at eight and came back at five.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain where you parked and the time period. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 車体の色や、目印になる物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: What color is it, and does it have any identifying features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 銀色で、前のかごに青いひもを結んでいます。写真もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 色と目印を伝え写真があると知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's silver, with a blue cord tied to the front basket. I also have a photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the color and identifying feature, and say you have a photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真を見せてください。鍵は掛けていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show me the photo. Had you locked it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 後ろの車輪の鍵を掛けました。防犯登録の控えは家にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 施錠と防犯登録控えの所在を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I locked the rear wheel. The copy of my bicycle security registration is at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say how you locked it and where your security registration copy is. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 控えの番号も調べる手がかりになります。駐輪場の撤去案内はご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The number on that copy will also help us investigate. Have you looked at the bicycle parking area's removal notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだ見ていません。控えを持ってきて、撤去案内の写真も見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控えと撤去案内を用意する予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not yet. I'll bring the registration copy and show you a photo of the removal notice too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you plan to prepare the registration copy and removal notice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。戻られたら、こちらの窓口でお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. When you come back, please speak to us at this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この箱をお送りですね。宛名のラベルを見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're sending this box, correct? May I see the address label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、家で印刷しました。文字が薄いのですが、このまま使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薄い宛名ラベルを使用できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I printed it at home. The print is faint; can I use it as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can use a faint address label. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 住所の一部が読み取りにくいので、こちらのラベルに書き直していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Part of the address is hard to read. Could you write it again on this label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: わかりました。送り先は携帯電話に入っていますが、それを見ながら書いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 携帯電話の住所を見ながら記入してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. The destination address is on my phone. May I write it while looking at that?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may copy the address from your phone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。郵便番号と住所、お名前を順にお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please write the postal code, address and name in that order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住所が長いので、この二段を使っても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 長い住所の記入欄を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The address is long. Is it okay to use these two lines?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm where to write a long address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 大丈夫です。建物名と部屋番号も省かずにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's fine. Please don't leave out the building name or apartment number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 書けました。送り主の欄には、自分の住所を書きますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 送り主欄に自分の住所を記入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Done. I'll write my own address in the sender section.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll enter your own address in the sender section. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。書き終わったら、印刷した古いラベルはこちらで外します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. When you've finished writing, we'll remove the old printed label here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しいラベルを書き終えました。古いほうを外してから、これを貼ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新ラベルの完成を伝え貼り替えを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've finished the new label. Please remove the old one before sticking this on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say the new label is complete and ask them to replace the old one. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらで受付を進めます。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll go ahead with accepting the parcel, then. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通帳についてのお問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about your passbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、記帳機に入れたら、そのまま戻ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記帳機から通帳が返されたことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. When I put it in the passbook updating machine, it came straight back out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the updating machine returned your passbook. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 画面には何と表示されていましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 新しい通帳が必要、と出ていました。最後のページまで使っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画面の表示と通帳の使用状況を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It said I need a new passbook. I've used it through the last page.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the screen message and explain how full the passbook is. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記入欄がいっぱいですね。窓口で新しい通帳へ繰り越しますので、お預かりしてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The entry spaces are full. We'll carry it over to a new passbook at the counter. May I take it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。古い通帳も返してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 繰り越しを依頼し旧通帳の返却を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, please. Will I get the old passbook back too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask them to carry it over and ask whether the old passbook will be returned. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、繰り越し後に両方お返しします。古い通帳に挟んでいる紙は、お取りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, we'll return both afterward. Please remove the paper tucked into the old passbook.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この家賃のメモですね。外しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 挟んだメモを外すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: You mean this rent note. I'll take it out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll remove the note tucked inside. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。新しい通帳の表紙のお名前も、ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. Please also check your name on the cover of the new passbook.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前は合っています。これからは新しいほうを記帳機に入れますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表紙の名前と使う通帳を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: The name is correct. From now on I'll put the new one in the updating machine, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the name on the cover and which passbook to use. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、こちらをお使いください。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please use this one. Thank you for visiting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのトマト、一つ皮が破れています。別のパックをお持ちしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: The skin of one tomato in this pack is split. Shall I bring you another pack?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。小さいトマトが六つ入った物がいいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 交換を依頼し欲しいパックを指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, please. I'd like one with six small tomatoes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a replacement and specify the pack you want. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ六個入りをお持ちします。ほかの商品を先に読み取ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll bring the same six-pack. May I scan your other items first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、お願いします。卵は最後に袋へ入れたいので、横に置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会計を進めることを了承し卵の置き方を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, please. I want to put the eggs in my bag last, so please set them to the side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Agree to continue checkout and ask them to set the eggs aside. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 卵はこちらへ置きますね。新しいトマトが届きましたので、ご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll put the eggs here. The fresh pack of tomatoes is here now; please take a look.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今度は傷がありません。同じ値段ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 交換品を確認し値段を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: These aren't damaged. Are they the same price?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the replacement and ask the price. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、二百九十八円です。全部で千二百四十円になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, 298 yen. The total is 1,240 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 千円札と、二百四十円を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現金で支払う額を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll give you a thousand-yen note and 240 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the amount of cash you'll pay. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ちょうどお預かりしました。袋はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's the exact amount. Do you have a bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この袋を使います。卵を上に載せて持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持参袋と卵の入れ方を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll use this bag. I'll take them home with the eggs on top.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you brought a bag and will put the eggs on top. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: レシートはこちらです。ありがとうございました。
